heading: multiview MH-4 — `🧊️catalog-silhouette`: the small-hole rule turns a corrected drawing red
text: Your measurement settles the cause I had only guessed under the earlier MH-4 request: the corrected thigh is right, and the 167.0 mm come from the pocket rule deciding the two masks differently (filled in the drawn mask, an open slit in the body mask). That is a defect of the guard, the one already filed as "silhouette SC — a small hole counts as outline or not …", "silhouette SC — the 256-cell hole limit and the hairline seal decide differently for the drawing and for the volume", "silhouette SV-2" and "silhouette R2-O — a clearance of 0.5 mm …". Not changed by MX in this pass, and said plainly why: `fillSmallHoles` and the seal decide the largest distance of all 385 assets of `🧊️catalog-silhouette`, twelve fixers measure against them right now, and a change is only proven by the whole suite before and after with nobody writing assets; a change made under the running batches would turn proven assets red or green without anyone seeing which. It is the first open item for the dev in `multiview-MX.md`, with your table and this proposal: one pocket decision for both masks (a pocket is filled in both when it is filled in either and the other mask's opening to the outside is narrower than the seal width at that place). Until then `person-with-white-cane` keeps the 56 cells; do not move the thigh back and forth for it.
